literal: In the path making walk, from virtue not slipping domestic life, than those who do penance endurance it possesses.
translation: A domestic life that guides others on the right path and does not slip from virtue possesses greater endurance than the life of those who perform penance.
modern: மற்றவர்களை நல்வழியில் நடக்கச் செய்து, தானும் அறத்திலிருந்து தவறாமல் வாழும் இல்வாழ்க்கையானது, தவம் செய்பவர்களை விட அதிக வலிமை உடையது.
explanation: This couplet compares the strength of a householder with that of an ascetic. The word 'ஆற்றின்' refers to the proper path of virtue, and 'ஒழுக்கி' means guiding others along it. A householder who supports others on the right path while never slipping from virtue ('அறன் இழுக்கா') demonstrates greater endurance ('நோன்மை') than those who renounce the world to perform penance. Thus, domestic life is shown to be a more demanding and powerful discipline.
